verdict.rationale: Clara has no CLI or CI runner, but its documented REST API gives headless programmatic control over cards, transactions, users and invoices. Its sandbox lets automated pipelines test integrations end-to-end without real financial operations, and API credentials are self-managed from the dashboard. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless client, documented CI/CD integration guidance (e.g. pipeline examples or service-account and non-interactive auth flows for CI), and independent corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Clara API gives you programmatic control over every aspect of corporate spend management — issue and manage cards, retrieve transactions, handle users, process invoices
Clara provides a sandbox environment for testing your integration end-to-end without affecting real data or triggering real financial operations.
API credentials are managed directly from the Clara dashboard — no need to contact support for each new project.
